beforeClose.title: Kyro Work
beforeClose.objective: Entregar un camino Kyro Work de elección explícita para ejecutar cualquier plan mediante tareas verificables y estado escrito sólo por CLI, preservando los contratos actuales de Forge.
successCriteria: Una persona puede elegir Work para un plan de cualquier tamaño y completar tareas con dependencias, evidencia y revisión sin crear un scope o sprint para ese plan.
Cada cambio de work.json proviene de un comando CLI que valida el esquema exacto, la revisión esperada y la transición antes de persistir.
Después de una sesión nueva, un context pack de Work identifica la próxima acción y tarea elegible sin consultar un scope.
Cambios de brief, tarea o evidencia invalidan aprobaciones afectadas y el cierre nunca oculta trabajo pendiente.
Los comandos Work no modifican estado Forge existente, y la promoción explícita a Forge mantiene un enlace de origen y destino verificable.

requirements.statement: Work se crea y continúa únicamente por elección explícita del usuario, sin restricciones de complejidad, duración o número conceptual de tareas.
requirements.rationale: Decisión del usuario: Forge y Work son métodos distintos; la complejidad no selecciona el camino.

requirements.statement: El estado Work usa un work.json v1 de claves exactas, tipos concretos, referencias válidas y transiciones coherentes.
requirements.rationale: El contrato normativo y todos los campos se definen en el plan Idea 2026-09-26-organic-work.md; rechazar claves desconocidas evita ambigüedad.

requirements.statement: El CLI es el único escritor de work.json y protege cada mutación mediante validación, revisión esperada, bloqueo y persistencia segura.
requirements.rationale: Evita que agentes construyan manualmente estados o aprobaciones inválidos; dry-run debe permanecer de sólo lectura.

requirements.statement: Cada Work mantiene un brief legible ligado por digest a su estado y, si existe, a la Idea de origen.
requirements.rationale: La intención humana permanece rastreable y las ediciones externas del brief no cambian silenciosamente el contrato vigente.

requirements.statement: Work permite planificar y ejecutar tareas con criterios, dependencias acíclicas y bloqueo explícito sin habilitar dependientes de tareas no verificadas.
requirements.rationale: Un plan puede evolucionar, pero el orden y la cobertura deben reflejar el grafo de trabajo real.

requirements.statement: La evidencia y la revisión de cada tarea son registradas por CLI y un pass cubre todos los criterios vigentes y material no obsoleto.
requirements.rationale: Reutiliza la garantía maker/checker de Kyro sin heredar sprint.json ni afirmar certificación integral.

requirements.statement: Las enmiendas al brief o a tareas invalidan aprobaciones afectadas y preservan razón e historial de cambio.
requirements.rationale: La adaptación orgánica no puede conservar un pass anterior sobre un contrato distinto.

requirements.statement: El cierre distingue trabajo verificado, dispuesto y pendiente, y exige una razón explícita para detener trabajo incompleto.
requirements.rationale: Ninguna tarea desaparece ni un cierre parcial se presenta como resultado completo.

requirements.statement: Status y context pack Work muestran un siguiente paso determinista y suficiente para reanudar sin leer estado Forge.
requirements.rationale: La reanudación debe funcionar después de compactación o cambio de agente con contexto acotado.

requirements.statement: Los artefactos Work pueden versionarse en Git y se instalan/proyectan mediante los hosts soportados sin cambiar comandos Forge existentes.
requirements.rationale: La configuración ignore actual excluye .agents/kyro/work; empaquetado y proyección requieren pruebas de compatibilidad.

requirements.statement: Todas las operaciones Work mantienen aislados project.json, local.json y sprint.json y rechazan rutas inseguras, symlinks y estados corruptos.
requirements.rationale: Protege seguridad y comportamiento actual de Forge; se comprueba con snapshots y pruebas de fallos.

requirements.statement: Una promoción Work a Forge requiere solicitud explícita, vista previa y vínculo recíproco verificable antes de marcar Work como promovido.
requirements.rationale: La convergencia futura transfiere sólo trabajo pendiente válido y nunca equipara revisión Work con QA Forge.

scenarios.given: A Work plan proposal has duplicate task IDs, a missing dependency, or a cycle
scenarios.when: the CLI previews or applies the plan
scenarios.then: it reports the invalid graph and preserves the prior Work state

scenarios.given: A task is explicitly blocked while another independent task is eligible
scenarios.when: the CLI derives the next task and an agent tries to start a dependent task
scenarios.then: the independent task remains runnable and the dependent start is rejected until its prerequisite is verified

scenarios.given: Task evidence is stale, incomplete, failed, or not_run for a current criterion
scenarios.when: a checker requests pass
scenarios.then: the CLI rejects approval without a verified state or a misleading pass verdict

scenarios.given: A verified task or a Work brief has a current digest and a passing review
scenarios.when: the CLI applies a reasoned task or brief amendment at the expected revision
scenarios.then: the affected approval becomes non-current, the new contract is digest-bound, and historical activity remains auditable

scenarios.given: A dependent task references a prerequisite that is changed or disposed
scenarios.when: the CLI recomputes graph eligibility and handoff
scenarios.then: it never auto-rewires dependencies or starts the dependent before an explicit valid amendment

scenarios.given: A brief and work.json are valid before an amendment
scenarios.when: the update encounters a stale revision or an injected publication failure
scenarios.then: readers observe the prior accepted contract or a recoverable transaction, never an apparently approved mixed revision

scenarios.given: A task is cancelled or superseded with an explicit reason
scenarios.when: the Work is summarized or closed
scenarios.then: the task is counted as disposed rather than verified and unresolved dependents remain visible

scenarios.given: A Work is closed with a reason and retained closure provenance
scenarios.when: the user explicitly reopens it
scenarios.then: the CLI restores a valid actionable state without erasing the earlier closure or allowing a promoted Work to reopen

scenarios.given: A supported host installs or syncs Kyro assets in a workspace
scenarios.when: a user explicitly invokes the Work entry point
scenarios.then: the Work router is available and Forge command assets and state remain unchanged

scenarios.given: A Work has unfinished tasks and a fresh Forge target has been explicitly chosen
scenarios.when: the CLI previews promotion
scenarios.then: it shows deterministic task and dependency mapping, excluded source history, approval reset, and exact reciprocal identities without writing either workflow

scenarios.given: A promotion is interrupted or its source, pending record, staged target, or reciprocal link is changed
scenarios.when: the CLI reads or retries the transaction
scenarios.then: only a matching retry completes; every mismatch fails closed without reporting a healthy promoted Work or an incomplete runnable Forge scope

scenarios.given: A Work has verified, disposed, blocked, and unfinished tasks with dependencies
scenarios.when: the user chooses a new Forge scope for promotion
scenarios.then: only eligible unfinished tasks become pending Forge tasks, disposed prerequisites block promotion, verified dependencies are disclosed and adjudicated explicitly, and no Work pass becomes Forge QA

scenarios.given: A create source contains malformed UTF-8, a symlink, or valid Unicode and CRLF bytes
scenarios.when: the CLI reads and publishes the initial brief
scenarios.then: invalid or unsafe sources are rejected without publication and valid original bytes are preserved with the matching digest

scenarios.given: A Work has been promoted with a valid reciprocal link
scenarios.when: the user attempts to reopen it
scenarios.then: the CLI rejects reopening without altering either Work or Forge state and an automated fixture protects this rule

scenarios.given: A workspace has an absent, healthy, or unsafe Work root, with or without Forge scopes
scenarios.when: artifact doctor audits the workspace
scenarios.then: it skips only a genuinely absent root, verifies healthy Work, and reports every present unsafe or unreadable root as a failure without changing Work or Forge bytes

nonGoals: Seleccionar Work o Forge automáticamente según tamaño o dificultad.
Permitir edición manual de work.json como parte del flujo normal o reparación.
Cambiar el esquema, enrutamiento, cierre o QA actual de Forge.
Migrar Forge a Work en la primera versión o mantener estado vivo compartido entre ambos.
Ejecutar delegados por defecto o declarar QA integral a partir de revisiones de tarea.

roadmap.sizingRationale: Cuatro incrementos con objetivos verificables: (1) contrato exacto, persistencia segura, create/status/context pack e aislamiento; (2) grafo de tareas, evidencia y revisión; (3) enmiendas, cierre, entrada pública e instalación; (4) promoción Work a Forge y certificación integral. La promoción depende de los contratos y pruebas previos; los sprints posteriores pueden ajustarse mediante CLI tras la evidencia, sin adelantar ejecución ni cierre.

sprints.title: Organic Change, Closure, and Public Entry

recommendations: Implement CLI-owned brief and task amendments with revision invalidation and preserved history.
Implement Work closure with explicit dispositions and truthful partial outcomes.
Expose Work through the supported public command and installation surfaces without changing Forge behavior.
Plan Sprint 4 around explicit, previewed Work-to-Forge promotion with reciprocal links and S16 coverage.
Resolve debt-1 and debt-2 before release; then bump the package version and verify an authorized install/sync and doctor handshake.
At a separate release gate, decide whether to bump and publish the workspace build, install/sync the global runtime and kyro-work adapter, then rerun workspace artifact doctor.
Ask the scope owner whether to complete organic-work or explicitly expand it; do not start another sprint automatically.

previousSprint.summary: Delivered explicit Work-to-Forge promotion with recoverable reciprocal publication and certified Work/Forge isolation.

activeSprint.title: Work Artifact Doctor Hardening
activeSprint.objective: Make artifact doctor fail closed for unsafe Work roots and audit Work-only workspaces without changing Work or Forge state contracts.

phases.title: Fail-closed Work discovery
phases.objective: Correct Work-root discovery and certify it with disposable workspaces.

tasks.title: Audit Work roots independently of Forge scopes
tasks.description: Distinguish a genuinely absent Work root from an unsafe or unreadable one, include Work checks in Work-only workspaces, and add regression coverage for discovery and isolation.
tasks.context: A senior cross-feature QA reproduced a false omission: replacing an existing Work root with a symlink to an empty directory removes its doctor check. Only ENOENT for the root is a normal absence. A present root symlink, non-directory, or listing error must be a named Work-root failure with a remedy; an unsafe ancestor is rejected earlier by the shared managed-path guard. Work-only workspaces must be audited even if Forge scope discovery returns none. Keep Sprint 4 archives immutable. Prior Sprint 4 release and global-install recommendations remain deferred to a separate owner gate; the user explicitly authorized this corrective scope expansion.
acceptance_criteria: A Forge-only workspace with no Work root retains the existing no-Work behavior; a healthy Work-only workspace receives a Work diagnostic despite having no Forge scope.

A Work root that is a symlink, a regular file, or unreadable fails doctor with a named Work-root check and actionable remedy instead of silently producing zero Work checks; an unsafe symlink ancestor fails closed in the shared managed-path guard before artifact checks.
Disposable fixtures prove the unsafe-root cases, healthy Work with Forge scopes, Work status fail-closed behavior, and byte isolation of unrelated Forge project/local/sprint files.

Build, targeted Work and Forge checks, full npm run check, adapter checks, artifact doctor, analyze, package dry-run, and git diff --check pass or have explicitly reported environment-only limits; no release, version bump, global installation, commit, or push is claimed.

evidence.summary: Aligned the active task context with the approved unsafe-ancestor behavior; the Work-root doctor implementation and regression suite remain unchanged and passing.
evidence.validation: The independent seven-configuration S31 probe passed. npm run check:work-doctor passed after the context correction. Earlier build, full npm run check, adapters, installed artifact doctor, package dry-run, and git diff --check passed on the unchanged source; analyze will be repeated after review.

checked_criteria: A Forge-only workspace with no Work root retains the existing no-Work behavior; a healthy Work-only workspace receives a Work diagnostic despite having no Forge scope.

A Work root that is a symlink, a regular file, or unreadable fails doctor with a named Work-root check and actionable remedy instead of silently producing zero Work checks; an unsafe symlink ancestor fails closed in the shared managed-path guard before artifact checks.
Disposable fixtures prove the unsafe-root cases, healthy Work with Forge scopes, Work status fail-closed behavior, and byte isolation of unrelated Forge project/local/sprint files.

Build, targeted Work and Forge checks, full npm run check, adapter checks, artifact doctor, analyze, package dry-run, and git diff --check pass or have explicitly reported environment-only limits; no release, version bump, global installation, commit, or push is claimed.

definitionOfDone: T5.1 has CLI-recorded evidence and a passing checker review.
The new disposable fixture and aggregate checks pass without Forge-state changes.
Independent read-only Kyro QA approves the Work-root remediation before Sprint 5 closes.

debt.note: Bounded no-follow lossless UTF-8 ingestion applied to work create with byte-exact publication and digest over original bytes; check-work-store, check-work-isolation, and check-work-amend pass.

debt.note: Added schema-valid CLI-promoted reopen-refusal regression in check-work-closure plus status/doctor reciprocal diagnostics; fixtures pass.

scenarios.when: the CLI reads and publishes the initial brief
scenarios.then: invalid or unsafe sources are rejected without publication and valid original bytes are preserved with the matching digest

scenarios.given: A Work has been promoted with a valid reciprocal link
scenarios.when: the user attempts to reopen it
scenarios.then: the CLI rejects reopening without altering either Work or Forge state and an automated fixture protects this rule

scenarios.given: A workspace has an absent, healthy, or unsafe Work root, with or without Forge scopes
scenarios.when: artifact doctor audits the workspace
scenarios.then: it skips only a genuinely absent root, verifies healthy Work, and reports every present unsafe or unreadable root as a failure without changing Work or Forge bytes

nonGoals: Seleccionar Work o Forge automáticamente según tamaño o dificultad.
Permitir edición manual de work.json como parte del flujo normal o reparación.
Cambiar el esquema, enrutamiento, cierre o QA actual de Forge.
Migrar Forge a Work en la primera versión o mantener estado vivo compartido entre ambos.
Ejecutar delegados por defecto o declarar QA integral a partir de revisiones de tarea.

roadmap.sizingRationale: Cuatro incrementos con objetivos verificables: (1) contrato exacto, persistencia segura, create/status/context pack e aislamiento; (2) grafo de tareas, evidencia y revisión; (3) enmiendas, cierre, entrada pública e instalación; (4) promoción Work a Forge y certificación integral. La promoción depende de los contratos y pruebas previos; los sprints posteriores pueden ajustarse mediante CLI tras la evidencia, sin adelantar ejecución ni cierre.

sprints.title: Organic Change, Closure, and Public Entry

recommendations: Implement CLI-owned brief and task amendments with revision invalidation and preserved history.
Implement Work closure with explicit dispositions and truthful partial outcomes.
Expose Work through the supported public command and installation surfaces without changing Forge behavior.
Plan Sprint 4 around explicit, previewed Work-to-Forge promotion with reciprocal links and S16 coverage.
Resolve debt-1 and debt-2 before release; then bump the package version and verify an authorized install/sync and doctor handshake.
At a separate release gate, decide whether to bump and publish the workspace build, install/sync the global runtime and kyro-work adapter, then rerun workspace artifact doctor.
Ask the scope owner whether to complete organic-work or explicitly expand it; do not start another sprint automatically.
Review the scope-completion preview and decide whether to complete organic-work; defer commit, push, version bump, release, and global installation to separate authorization.
